title: Opening the diagnostic valve separates the moving seal from its seat

per_part_functions.fuel-test-body: Connects the existing open rail branch to the diagnostic cartridge and provides the cap interface. Thread and installed dimensions remain provisional.
per_part_functions.fuel-test-core: Supports the annular valve seat and guides the actuating pin. With the cap removed and pin depressed, the intended path crosses the opened seat and exits through the upper bore.
per_part_functions.fuel-test-static-seal: Intended to prevent flow around the outside of the cartridge. The current uncompressed study leaves0.01 mm radial clearance at its inner interface, so leak-tight bypass isolation is not established.
per_part_functions.fuel-test-pin: Moves inward together with the seating washer to open the intended diagnostic passage. The isolated adapter samples0..0.12 mm only; actual stroke is unknown and no viewer animation is integrated by this module alone.
per_part_functions.fuel-test-seat-seal: The washer travels with the poppet. Its closed face blocks the tested seat-crossing path; depressing it opens that path. Elastomer compression and leakage are not simulated.
per_part_functions.fuel-test-spring: Shortens as the pin is depressed and would supply the return force. The existing four-turn envelope retains non-intersecting pitch over the illustrative interval; no real force or preload is assigned.
per_part_functions.fuel-test-cap: Covers the valve and provides a secondary protective/sealing boundary in the installed state. It is excluded, together with its seal, before the isolated opening state is constructed. Gauge attachment is not modeled.
per_part_functions.fuel-test-cap-seal: Illustrative annular insert at the body lip beneath the cap. It accompanies cap removal; its material, compression and actual installed construction remain unresolved.

mechanism: The actuating pin carries its sealing washer away from the core seat. The spring shortens while the intended passage opens around the poppet. The closed-state control blocks that same passage. The cap is removed from the geometric working state; no servicing procedure or tool attachment is simulated.
what_is_tested: Sampled geometric clearance and intended-passage connectivity using the existing rail datum and installed neighboring parts.
what_is_not_tested: Actual stroke, pressure, discharge, seal compression, fuel compatibility, leakage, spring calibration and safe servicing. The existing static-seal clearance remains unresolved.
